abstract: Mediastinal teratomas are typically benign and asymptomatic, but they undergo sudden enlargement or rupture into neighboring organs in some patients owing to intratumoral hemorrhage, leading to serious complications. We report the case of a mediastinal mature teratoma that was discovered because of the sudden onset of chest pain accompanied by elevated preoperative serum CA19-9 levels. The patient was a 43-year-old man who experienced sudden chest pain and was brought to hospital in an ambulance. Chest radiography and computed tomography revealed a mediastinal tumor and a serum CA19-9 level that was elevated to 4377 U/ml. The tumor comprised soft tissue, fluid, and cystic components. The histological diagnosis was mature teratoma with peritumoral bleeding. Most epithelial components, including squamous epithelium and similar components in the bronchi, showed positive results for CA19-9 on immunohistological examination. The postoperative course was uneventful, and serum CA19-9 levels normalized.
abstract_ja: 縦隔奇形腫は通常は良性で無症候性であるが、一部の患者では腫瘍内出血により急激に増大したり、隣接臓器へ破裂したりし、重篤な合併症を引き起こすことがある。本報告では、突然の胸痛で発症し、術前の血清CA19-9高値を伴った縦隔成熟奇形腫の症例を報告する。患者は43歳の男性で、救急車で搬送された。胸部X線検査とコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で縦隔腫瘍を認め、血清CA19-9は4377 U/mlに上昇していた。腫瘍は充実性、液体、嚢胞性の成分から構成されていた。病理組織診断は周囲出血を伴う成熟奇形腫であった。扁平上皮や気管支様の成分などほとんどの上皮成分は、免疫組織化学染色でCA19-9陽性を示した。術後経過は順調で、血清CA19-9は正常化した。
